title: Thakaa at StanceEval-2026: Inference-Time Target Grounding for Arabic Stance Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.28860v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: StanceEval-2026 tests Arabic stance classification under target shift, with evaluation targets absent from the labelled task data. We test two ways to supply target information at inference time. For Track 1, we retrieve eight labelled Women Driving demonstrations from the external ArabicStanceX corpus and score the three label tokens with Gemma-4-31B-IT. For the unseen-target track, we prepend cached target context prompted to be factual and non-evaluative, then fuse label predictions and label-token scores from multiple LLMs, with final assignments constrained by published class totals. The systems obtain 85.22 and 91.78 Favg2 on Tracks 1 and 2, ranking sixth and fourth in the final standings. On held-out ArabicStanceX tweets, direct prompting scores 79.45 Favg2; eight random Women Driving demonstrations raise it to 84.78, and similarity retrieval reaches 89.04. translated_title: Thakaa 在 StanceEval-2026 上的表现：面向阿拉伯语立场检测的推理时目标锚定
translated_abstract: StanceEval-2026 在目标偏移的场景下测试阿拉伯语立场分类，评估目标在带标注的任务数据中并不存在。我们测试了两种在推理时提供目标信息的方法。对于赛道1，我们从外部 ArabicStanceX 语料库中检索八个带标注的“女性驾驶”示例，并用 Gemma-4-31B-IT 对三个标签词元进行打分。对于未见目标赛道，我们前置缓存的目标上下文（通过提示词约束其仅陈述事实且不带评价性），然后融合多个大语言模型的标签预测与标签词元得分，最终分配结果受公开的类别总数约束。两个系统在赛道1和赛道2上分别取得 85.22 和 91.78 的 Favg²，在最终排名中位列第六和第四。在留出的 ArabicStanceX 推文上，直接提示得分为 79.45 Favg²；八个随机的“女性驾驶”示例将其提升至 84.78，而相似度检索则达到 89.04。在三个目标留出的 Mawqif 评估中，固定目标卡片提升（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出在推理时为阿拉伯语立场检测的大语言模型补充目标信息——通过从外部语料库检索带标注示例以及注入事实性、非评价性的目标上下文，并融合多个模型的标签预测，在 StanceEval-2026 的目标偏移场景下取得赛道1第六、赛道2第四的成绩，且证明基于相似度的示例检索能显著提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper grounds stance targets at inference time by retrieving labeled demonstrations from an external corpus and injecting factual, non-evaluative target context, fusing predictions from multiple LLMs, achieving 6th and 4th place on StanceEval-2026 Arabic stance detection under target shift, with similarity-based retrieval shown to substantially boost performance.
